items.context: You are a member of your company's social committee.
items.prompt: Suggest one activity for the next team event and explain why colleagues would enjoy it. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I suggest a cooking class after work. Everyone can learn something new, and it would help colleagues from different departments get to know each other.

note.en: Neutral and polite for proposing an idea to a committee.
note.es: Neutro y educado para proponer una idea a un comité.

note.en: Adds a second benefit.
note.es: Añade un segundo beneficio.

note.en: The natural phrasal expression for becoming acquainted.
note.es: Expresión natural para empezar a conocerse.

c.text: A cooking class after work would be ideal. Beyond being fun, it would bring together colleagues who rarely speak, fostering the kind of teamwork no memo could achieve.

note.en: 'Beyond' + gerund adds a benefit to the obvious one.
note.es: «Beyond» + gerundio añade un beneficio al más evidente.

note.en: A precise phrasal verb for uniting people.
note.es: Phrasal verb preciso para unir a las personas.

note.en: A present participle clause states the result.
note.es: Una cláusula de participio de presente expresa el resultado.

note.en: A contact relative clause with a vivid contrast.
note.es: Relativo sin pronombre, con un contraste vivo.

items.context: You are a student on an evening course in public speaking.
items.prompt: Tell us why you chose the course and what you would like to improve. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I chose this course because I get nervous when I speak in meetings. I would like to sound more confident and organise my ideas better.

note.en: Gives the reason for your choice.
note.es: Da el motivo de tu elección.

note.en: 'Get' + adjective describes a change of feeling.
note.es: «Get» + adjetivo describe un cambio de estado.

note.en: 'When' links the feeling to the situation.
note.es: «When» une el sentimiento con la situación.

note.en: 'Sound' + adjective is natural for how you come across.
note.es: «Sound» + adjetivo es natural para la impresión que causas.

c.text: Nerves have always held me back in meetings, which is why I enrolled. Above all, I'd like to project more confidence and structure my arguments more persuasively.

note.en: A phrasal verb meaning 'prevented my progress'.
note.es: Phrasal verb que significa «me ha frenado».

note.en: A relative clause links the problem to your decision.
note.es: Una cláusula de relativo une el problema con tu decisión.

note.en: Marks your main goal.
note.es: Marca tu objetivo principal.

note.en: Precise verb, noun and adverb for a speaking skill.
note.es: Verbo, sustantivo y adverbio precisos para una habilidad oral.

items.context: You volunteer with a local river clean-up group.
items.prompt: Explain what you enjoy about volunteering with the group and what you think it achieves. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I enjoy being outdoors and working with friendly people. I think the group achieves a lot, because our river is cleaner and more people care about it.

note.en: 'Enjoy' is followed by a gerund.
note.es: «Enjoy» va seguido de gerundio.

annotations.quote: I think the group achieves a lot

note.en: 'I think' gives an opinion in a neutral way.
note.es: «I think» expresa una opinión de forma neutra.

note.en: Supports your opinion with evidence.
note.es: Apoya tu opinión con una prueba.

note.en: 'Care about' means to feel concern for something.
note.es: «Care about» significa que algo te importa.

c.text: What I enjoy most is the camaraderie of working side by side outdoors. Our efforts have visibly improved the river, and, just as importantly, they've raised local awareness.

note.en: A cleft sentence that highlights what you value.
note.es: Una oración hendida que destaca lo que más valoras.

note.en: A precise word for friendship among people who work together.
note.es: Palabra precisa para el compañerismo entre quienes trabajan juntos.

note.en: Adds a second result of equal weight.
note.es: Añade un segundo resultado de igual peso.

note.en: A common collocation for making people more informed.
note.es: Colocación frecuente para informar y concienciar.

items.context: You are a member of a neighbourhood association.
items.prompt: Say what you would like to improve in your area and how it would help residents. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I would like a safe cycle lane on our main street. It would help residents because fewer people would need cars, and the air would be cleaner.

note.en: The standard British term for a bike path on the road.
note.es: Término británico estándar para el carril bici.

note.en: Links the improvement to its benefit.
note.es: Une la mejora con su beneficio.

note.en: 'Fewer' is used with countable nouns like 'people'.
note.es: «Fewer» se usa con sustantivos contables como «people».

annotations.quote: and the air would be cleaner

note.en: 'And' adds a second benefit.
note.es: «And» añade un segundo beneficio.

c.text: Were the council to introduce a protected cycle lane on our high street, traffic would ease and the air would improve, benefiting residents of every age.

note.en: Inversion replaces 'If the council introduced'; it is formal but natural in writing.
note.es: La inversión sustituye a «If the council introduced»; es formal pero natural al escribir.

note.en: 'Protected' makes the proposal more specific.
note.es: «Protected» hace la propuesta más concreta.

note.en: 'Ease' is a precise verb for a problem becoming less serious.
note.es: «Ease» es un verbo preciso para un problema que disminuye.

note.en: A participle clause shows the result of the changes.
note.es: Una cláusula de participio muestra el resultado de los cambios.

items.context: You are a member of a language exchange group that meets once a month.
items.prompt: Tell us what you like about the group and what would make it even better. Write in sentences. Use 20–30 words.

b2.text: I like the group because everyone is friendly and patient with my mistakes. It would be even better if we met more often, maybe every week.

note.en: Gives the reason for liking the group.
note.es: Da el motivo por el que te gusta el grupo.

note.en: 'Patient with' is the correct preposition here.
note.es: «Patient with» es la preposición correcta.

annotations.quote: It would be even better if we met

note.en: Second conditional for a polite suggestion.
note.es: Segundo condicional para una sugerencia educada.

note.en: 'Maybe' keeps the suggestion soft and informal.
note.es: «Maybe» mantiene la sugerencia suave e informal.

c.text: What I value most is how patient everyone is with my mistakes. Meeting weekly rather than monthly would make the group better, as friendships need regular contact to flourish.

note.en: A cleft sentence that puts your main appreciation first.
note.es: Una oración hendida que pone tu mayor aprecio en primer lugar.

note.en: A gerund subject with 'rather than' contrasts two options neatly.
note.es: Un gerundio como sujeto con «rather than» contrasta dos opciones con elegancia.

note.en: 'As' gives a reason in a compact, formal-leaning way.
note.es: «As» da una razón de forma compacta y algo formal.

note.en: A richer verb than 'grow' or 'develop'.
note.es: Verbo más rico que «grow» o «develop».
